definitions.gloss: to be convinced; to be certain; to firmly believe
definitions.explanation: To have a strong, unwavering belief that something is true or will happen. Implies deep personal conviction based on evidence or intuition, stronger than simply 'thinking' something.

examples.japanese: ⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{確信|かくしん}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{無実|むじつ}→無実：09504_mujitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{確信|かくしん}して⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I was convinced of his innocence.

examples.japanese: ⟦{証拠|しょうこ}→証拠：10575_shouko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧、⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{間違|まちが}いない→間違いない：17813_machigainai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{確信|かくしん}した。
examples.english: After seeing the evidence, I became certain that there was no mistake.

notes:
USAGE:
Expresses a stronger degree of certainty than ⟦{信|しん}じる→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧ (to believe). Often used when someone has strong grounds or evidence for their belief. The noun form ⟦{確信|かくしん}→確信：13682_kakushin⟧ is also commonly used on its own.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{確信|かくしん}→確信：13682_kakushin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ (to have conviction)
- ⟦{確信|かくしん}→確信：13682_kakushin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧ (to gain conviction)
- ⟦{確信|かくしん}→確信：13682_kakushin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧ (to turn into conviction)
- {確信犯|かくしんはん} (person who acts with full awareness that their actions are wrong)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{信|しん}じる→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧: to believe — broader and weaker; can include faith without evidence
- ⟦{確|たし}かめる→確かめる：01955_tashikameru⟧: to confirm, to verify — the act of checking, not the state of believing
